Patna High Court: Seeing Spouse in Compromising Position Not Proof of Adultery

The Patna High Court has ruled that merely seeing a spouse in a 'compromising position' is insufficient to prove adultery. The court stated that such an allegation alone does not constitute evidence of infidelity. This clarification aims to set a standard for proving adultery in legal proceedings. The ruling emphasizes the need for concrete evidence beyond mere observation of a potentially compromising situation.
